MEN's discipleship

Building community for MEn TO HELP them REFLECT HONESTY, PURSUE GOD WHOLEHEARTEDLY, AND LIVE LIFE WELL

Morning Study

Join the men every Friday morning from 6:30-7:30 for fellowship and an inductive Bible study through Genesis. Coffee and bagels are provided! No registration required. This group meets at the church.

Evening Study

Starting September 3rd, 2026, this group will meet on Thursday evenings at 6:30pm to study the life of Elijah. If you've been longing for more purpose and a deeper walk with God but aren't sure where to begin, you're not alone. Come join other men as we learn from Elijah's life about taking small, faithful steps toward the life God has for you. This group meets at the church.
